notes: No single official-roster institution/member/country count for the UA2 Collaboration was located; the CERN archives guide lists the 12 participating institutions by name, used here as institution_count with evidence_class 'official_institution_list'.

summary.plain: The international team of physicists who built and ran the UA2 detector at CERN, co-discovering the W and Z bosons with the UA1 Collaboration.
summary.technical: Formed around the 1978 UA2 proposal to CERN; approved 14 December 1978. Comprised groups from Bern, Cambridge, CERN, Dortmund, Heidelberg, Melbourne, Milano, Orsay (LAL), Pavia, Perugia, Pisa and Saclay (CEN); spokesmen were Pierre Darriulat (1978-1985) and Luigi Di Lella (1986-1992).
